country_label: Censo Escolar; Anuario Estadístico de la Educación
owner: Unidad de Estadística e Investigación, Dirección General de Planificación y Promoción Educativa, Ministry of Education; supported technically and financially by PRODEGE, which the government funds
tiers: each public or private school reports by questionnaire; the district inspectorates follow up and pass it on; the central statistics unit processes, analyses and publishes; covers infantil y preescolar, primaria, secundaria and formación técnica profesional; 1,017 pre-primary schools reported in 2020-2021
